title: Cloud Control Plane — canonical target architecture for the Oyatie Cloud IaaS/PaaS substrate
purpose: Target-architecture spec for the spine of the production-100 substrate-as-product (P-DEFINE: full cloud-* set live as a multi-region IaaS/PaaS across shared+dedicated deployment). Defines the canonical resource model, ORN, control-plane pipeline, per-resource-type contract, durable long-running operations, and the nine control-plane facets every cloud-* resource service must expose. Hyperscaler-shaped (AWS/GCP/Azure control planes: declarative resource registry + reconcilers + long-running operations + per-resource quota/billing/audit). Honest: target spec only — no control-plane API, registry, operation-ledger persistence, reconciler runtime, or provider provisioning is implemented or claimed here.

rules: Region and Cell are first-class in the hierarchy (not hidden in IaC internals).
Resource Group is required before any Resource.
tenant scope must include organization + account + project (ADR-0244).
every Resource is pinned to exactly one Region + Cell (ADR-0248 cellular; ADR-0254 shared logical / dedicated physical pinning).

control_plane_pipeline.ordering: API Gateway -> Resource Registry -> Operation Ledger -> Workflow/Reconciler -> OpenTofu/Operators/Argo
control_plane_pipeline.principle: OpenTofu and Argo are BACKEND mechanisms, not the public API. The public surface is the API Gateway + Resource Registry; reconciliation is declarative (desired state in the registry, reconcilers drive actual state).

stages.role: authenticated/authorized (Cedar, ADR-0243) public CRUD + query surface; emits typed requests; rate/quota enforced
system-of-record for desired resource state per the resource model; ORN-keyed; tenant/region/cell-scoped
durable long-running-operation state for every create/update/delete; idempotent; resumable; audit-linked
drives actual state toward desired (Workflow/Ontology adapter layer); retry/backoff; brown-out aware
OpenTofu modules / Kubernetes operators / Cluster API / ArgoCD perform the provider-side actuation; cosign-verified images (ADR-0181)

long_running_operations.requirement: Every create/update/delete is a durable long-running operation with explicit state (pending/running/succeeded/failed/rolled-back), an operation id, idempotency key, and audit-chain linkage.
guarantees: no partial-apply without a recorded compensating action

per_resource_type_contract.requirement: Every resource type declares all of:
per_resource_type_contract.rationale: mandatory quota/metering/billing/audit contract so the substrate is governable + billable + auditable per resource (ADR-0344 FinOps; ADR-0263 audit).

control_plane_facets.target: declarative create/update/delete via registry + reconciler; long-running-operation state
Cloud IAM principals + workload identity; tenant/account/project scoping (ADR-0244)
Cedar universal gate at the API Gateway + per-resource policy (ADR-0243); default-deny
per-tenant/per-resource-type quotas enforced at the gateway; brown-out degradation signal
billing_meters per resource -> metering -> invoice (Cloud Billing); FinOps export (ADR-0344)
per-resource SLO/metrics/traces (OpenTelemetry); SLO tier per resource (ADR-0340)
per-operation rollback + ArgoCD progressive-delivery auto-rollback on metric breach (ADR-0349)
continuous desired-vs-actual reconciliation; drift detection + correction

deployment_models_target.shared_cloud: logical isolation: cell + Cedar + per-tenant encryption; multi-tenant cells
deployment_models_target.dedicated_cloud: physical isolation: dedicated cell pinning per tenant; shuffle-shard pinning

compliance_overlays_target: KR + JP + US + EU pack overlays applied per tenant jurisdiction (P-DEFINE compliance gate); per-pack data-residency + cross-border-transfer constraints enforced at the control plane.
non_claims: Target-architecture spec only. No control-plane API, Resource Registry, Operation Ledger persistence, reconciler runtime, OpenTofu plan/apply, operator/Cluster-API/ArgoCD runtime, or provider provisioning is implemented or claimed.
No measured SLO/DR/scale/cost evidence; no production or hyperscaler-maturity claim. All such claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green per hyperscaler-gates.json.
cloud-* services remain metadata-only foundations until P-STRANGLE migrates each to this target behind contracts.
